exposure: Nonspinal surgical procedures (cesarean delivery, gastric sleeve surgery, dilatation and curettage, etc.)
cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with pyogenic spondylodiscitis (PS) following nonspinal surgical procedures at a tertiary care center
finding: Excellent clinical outcomes were achieved in all patients with PS following nonspinal surgeries at 12 months after treatment, with most being treated conservatively.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the most common surgical procedure (30%) associated with pyogenic spondylodiscitis.
